own_solution.law: Perfectly inelastic 2D collision; dK = (1/2) m1 m2/(m1+m2) (v1^2 + v2^2) for perpendicular velocities
assumptions: frictionless level ice, only the skaters exchange momentum

notes: Claims agree with pass 1. Checked R answers: q = 3.5 kg -> mu = 63.5x75/138.5 = 34.386 kg, dK = 429.83 J; q = 12 -> 36.735 kg, 459.18 J; q = 15 -> 37.5 kg, 468.75 J. Base 416.667 J. Minimal pairs: T3B70/T90B7 differ only in coach vs east skater (12 kg, present tense); T3DB2/T081E differ only in 'on an earlier outing only' vs 'through the whole glide and the collision' (12 kg, past tense). T9E17 and TAD96 are declared numeral-free twins, so the missing number is by design. The wiring text says the bag is 'picked up', whereas the sentences say it is carried; the computation (bag moving with the skater at 4 m/s) matches the sentences, so this is only loose wording in the rationale, not a defect.
